text:
Ivy Park: Heads-up: EU1 embed p95 spiked to 520ms after the midnight canary. Suspect KV cache TTL regression in v13.2.1. Rolling a hotfix v13.2.1-hotfix1. Can we fast-track? @Samir @Lena

deploy-bot: Release initiated: v13.2.1-hotfix1 (sha: ffeedd11) -> canary eu1. Steps: canary -> 30% -> 100%. CI: smoke checks running. Abort: /deploy cancel

Samir Rao: need explicit rollback plan before I ok. What's the undo command and metric thresholds?

Ivy Park: rollback if error rate > 0.8% sustained for 3m OR p95 > 350ms for 5m. Rollback cmd: k8s: kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/embeddings --to-revision=41. Runbook updated: https://goto/runbooks/embeds-hotfix

Lena Ortiz: i'll watch traces and synthetics. If we see tokenization errors or increased OOMs we abort. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

oncall-bot: Canary health: 20/20 checks pass. p95 180ms (baseline 135ms) at t+1m.

Ivy Park: shifting to 30% traffic.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift: to 30% complete. Autoscale OK.

Lena Ortiz: 4m into 30%: p95 drifting down toward baseline. No errors. KV refresh logs look good.

Samir Rao: +1 for full rollout. rollback steps posted.

Ivy Park: launching final shift to 100%. Will update release note after.

deploy-bot: Release complete: v13.2.1-hotfix1 deployed to prod eu1 at 1840000400. No rollback. All checks green.

Lena Ortiz: monitoring for 15m post-deploy. so far stable.

Ivy Park: thanks all — filing a short postmortem note and pinging support to update customers.
